children: stock rose 1.6% premarket on Friday after J.P. Morgan moved to an Overweight rating for the company.
The brokerage also set a December 2027 price target of $560 for the stock, implying an upside of nearly 9% to the last close.

“Despite a full clinical pipeline poised to build upon growth from its market-leading cystic fibrosis franchise, Vertex continues to expand its breadth with the recent Crinetics acquisition adding a fifth pillar, this time in endocrinology. We expect immediate topline contribution from Palsonify, and, in time, atumelnant, to make the deal accretive to operating income by 2029,” said J.P. Morgan analyst Jessica Fye.

Earlier in July, Vertex, well known for its cystic fibrosis franchise, completed the $10B transaction, adding Crinetics’ lead product, Palsonify, which is indicated in the U.S. for adults with acromegaly, a rare hormonal disorder affecting an

“Crinetics also brings a broad early-stage pipeline and what we view as an effective small-molecule discovery engine. As true specialty products, we see these assets fitting well within VRTX’s commercial model. Following healthy 2Q sales of $24mm, we model Palsonify delivering just north of $500mm in 2030 revs and see multi-billion dollar potential for atumelnant,” added Fye.
Fye also said that the investment firm expects VRTX’s core CF products Trikafta/Alyftrek to enjoy a long runway without meaningful competition.

Morgan Stanley, in September, also resumed its coverage with an Overweight recommendation and a $665 per share target on Vertex, citing diversification benefits from the company’s acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals.

title: Vertex trades higher after JPM gives bullish rating
